text:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy failed for release v1.4.3+build.45 on prod-canary (service: inference-api). 25% error rate, autoscaled back to previous. logs: https://ci.internal/logs/1795004321

marta: ugh. what did the canary show? regression or perf spike?

ci-bot: summary: 503 spikes from json-serializer when handling floats in embeddings response. Repro steps attached. SHA: a1b2c3d (built as v1.4.3+build.45).

alejandro: if it's the JSON serializer change we pulled in as a transitive, that sounds like a behavioral change. might not be safe as just build metadata.

sasha: btw quick reminder: we agreed buildmeta (+build) is for CI-only artifacts. Semver stable tags should be plain MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Using +build doesn't convey contract-semver decisions.

marta: question: do we rollback to v1.4.2 and cut a v1.4.3-patch, or fix on master and re-run canary as v1.4.3? I'm leaning rollback + patch to be safe during the change window.

release-manager: change window is still open for another 40m. My recommendation: rollback the canary, pin to v1.4.2, and open a hotfix branch to produce a proper v1.4.3 (patch). Rationale: customers expect fixes that don't change API semantics to be patches; this is a behavior change so patch makes sense but we must ensure release notes clearly state the serializer fix.

alejandro: agree. Also we should avoid using a plus-suffixed tag for public releases. Use annotated tag and changelog entry. Example commands:
```
git checkout -b hotfix/json-serializer-fix a1b2c3d~1
# apply fix
git commit -am "fix(json): restore float handling in serializer"
git tag -a v1.4.3 -m "v1.4.3: fix json serializer float handling (hotfix)"
git push origin hotfix/json-serializer-fix
git push origin v1.4.3
```

marta: sounds good. I'll trigger rollback now and create the hotfix branch. Can someone take release notes and add a short line about the regression + note to customers who hit it?

release-manager: I'll draft release notes: "v1.4.3 - Patch: fix JSON serializer edge case causing 5xx on certain float arrays. Backward compatible fix; recommended upgrade." Will attach links to repro and mitigation steps.

ci-bot: rollback executed: prod-canary now running v1.4.2 (SHA: f9e8d7c). Canary healthy at 0.4% errors.

sasha: postmortem note: we should add a quick pre-merge test for serializer rounding, and add a lint rule to flag risky transitive updates in PRs touching serialization deps.

marta: filed ticket INF-872 for pre-merge test + bot that comments if transitive serializer deps change. assigning to eng-ml and eng-runtime.

release-manager: final plan: cut v1.4.3 patch with tag (no +build metadata), publish changelog, and re-run canary after CI signs off. If CI passes, schedule a normal deploy outside emergency path. :white_check_mark:

alejandro: one last note for the docs: add a short section in release policy about when to prefer patch vs minor when a transitive dep causes behavior change. short rule: "if API contract or serialized output changes in any customer-observable way, increment patch and note it as a bug fix; only bump minor for new features or backward-incompatible changes."

marta: done. thanks all.

ci-bot: ticket created: INF-872, release branch created: hotfix/json-serializer-fix, tag pending v1.4.3 after approval.
